customer: Caller from Virginia said shes upgradin to a bigger car and thinks she owes more on her hybrid sedan then the ofer, wanted to know if she can still sell it and if she can pay the diffrence on her credit card.
agent: Customer asked about selling her hybrid sedan when the loan balance is higher than our offer. Explained per 'If you owe more than our offer' that this is negative equity and she can still sell us the car, paying the difference at the appointment after we compare the offer with her payoff letter. Advised we accept a cashier's check, debit card or personal check for that payment, but we can't accept credit cards.
